notes.title: Offical Release!
notes.notes:
You can now play the full version of [b]FL337![/b]
A big thank you to everyone who has supported the development of this game.

Notes
[list]
    [*]Improved performance across all platforms
    [*]Industrial ship now playable
    [*]Undead ship now playable
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE V0.2
notes.notes:
Impact-full changes in this update that improve the overall ascetic as well as fixes to improve user experience. There will be more frequent updates in the upcoming weeks which will include the next ship.

[h1]Changes[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Updated Camera settings to auto scale to 16:9 enabling support for more resolutions
    [*]Fixed bug where certain sound effects were not controlled by sound options
    [*]Improved foreground and background effects across all ships
    [*]Changed UI on Player sprint meter.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE V0.1
notes.notes:
Coming up to on the second week in early access this update contains some fixes and some minor adjustments.

[h1]Fixes[/h1] 
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug causing enemies to be stuck just off screen
    [*]Fixed bug where enemies could hit you without an animation
    [*]Adjusted default volume levels
    [*]Altered title screen
[/list]

notes.title: THIS IS AN EARLY ACCESS TITLE
notes.notes: There was a mistake and FL337 is listed as a full release but this is actually an early access title. We are working with Steam to resolve the issue. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: FL337 NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

After weeks of anticipation FL337 is finally available for purchase on the steam store. Please share FL337 with your friends, and leave us a Steam review. I'm looking forward to start getting feedback from everyone and to start implementing some new things as soon as possible.
